Meet your baker

Former reporter. English teacher. Now, your baker.

Ashton Packer is a former television reporter and 8th-grade English teacher who left the 9-to-5 to pursue the joy of creating treats that make occasions more special. She once entered the Georgia National Fair's baking competition and took first place for chocolate chip cookies and second for apple pie, so yes, the cakes taste as good as they look.

🏅 Best Chocolate Chip Cookies in Georgia
From backyard weddings to Cardi B's tour.

Three wedding-industry awards in 2026, The Knot, WeddingWire & Zola, plus a Delta Sky360° Club showpiece for Cardi B's Little Miss Drama Tour, and a growing Atlanta following who come for cakes as fun as they are flawless.
